name: spreader_broadcast
source: A centrifugal broadcast fertiliser spreader. It touches nothing: no draft, no soil force, no depth (kind applicator). It works while switched on over workable ground, moving forward; the width comes from the model's two work sockets, the mass from the vehicle. Rates and tank contents belong to the game.

range.source: [AS] Usual working speeds of a centrifugal spreader 8-15 km/h (manufacturer ranges, not read from a standard); the spread pattern degrades above 15 km/h, 0.08 per km/h to a floor of 0.5.
